title: abstract_text byte-slice panics on multi-byte UTF-8
description: delivery.rs:352 and posting.rs:1208. The abstract_text auto-generation uses `text[..end]` where `end` can be `text.len().min(200)` — a raw byte count. If the text contains multi-byte UTF-8 characters and byte 200 falls mid-character, this panics. The comment 'safe because find() returns byte offsets on ASCII delimiters' only applies when find() succeeds; the `unwrap_or_else(|| text.len().min(200))` fallback is NOT an ASCII delimiter position. Fix: use `text.floor_char_boundary(200)` or a loop to find the nearest char boundary <= 200.
